content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026 has been announced through two separate notifications issued on 11.08.2026 for filling the post of Second Division Assistant on the Establishment of the High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru, by way of Direct Recruitment. Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026 should note the following important dates before submitting the online application. Candidates are advised to submit their online applications well in advance and not wait until the last date to avoid last-minute rush, as stated in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 20 vacancies have been notified for the post of Second Division Assistant, spread across two notifications based on cadre. Within these 18 posts, horizontal reservation is also provided for Women, Rural, Kannada Medium, and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates as per the official notification. content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification and age limit prescribed in the official notification to be eligible for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026. Candidates must possess a Degree in Science / Arts / Commerce / Business Management / Computer Applications / Business Administration from a recognized University, along with knowledge of computer operation.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years (*) A one-time age relaxation of 5 years is applicable to all categories of candidates as per Government Order No. DPAR 262 SeNeNi 2025 dated 29.01.2026, as stated in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid only through the State Bank of India online payment gateway using Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, or UPI via the link provided in the online application. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances, and applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka High Court SDA Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the post of Second Division Assistant will be made on the basis of a Competitive Test (90 minutes duration) followed by an Interview. Candidates will be called for the Competitive Test in the order of merit based on percentage of marks in the qualifying examination, in the ratio of 1:10 (10 candidates per notified vacancy) within each reserved category. Candidates who clear the Competitive Test will be called for Interview in the ratio of 1:5 (5 candidates per notified vacancy) in each reserved category, in order of merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of the High Court of Karnataka at https://judiciary.karnataka.gov.in between 13.08.2026 and 11.09.2026 (11:59 PM). Applications submitted through any mode other than the online system will not be considered under any circumstances. Visit the official website: https://judiciary.karnataka.gov.in Fill in all required particulars in the online application form. Upload a recent colour photograph (5 cm x 3.6 cm, under 50 KB, JPG format, white background, without signature) and a scanned signature (2.5 cm x 7.5 cm, under 25 KB, JPG format). Pay the prescribed application fee through the khc online payment gateway. Download and retain a copy of the submitted application and fee payment receipt until the recruitment process is complete. A valid mobile number and e-mail ID must be furnished compulsorily, as all communication regarding the Competitive Test and Interview will be sent through SMS/e-mail and published on the official website. faq.question: Q1. What is Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the recruitment drive by the High Court of Karnataka, Bengaluru, to fill 20 vacancies of Second Division Assistant through Direct Recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies are available - 18 under the Residual Parent Cadre and 2 backlog posts under the Kalyana Karnataka Region.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 11.09.2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Degree in Science / Arts / Commerce / Business Management / Computer Applications / Business Administration from a recognized University, with the prescribed minimum aggregate marks and knowledge of computer operation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age ranges from 35 to 40 years (plus a 5-year one-time relaxation), depending on the candidate's category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 350/- for General Merit and OBC Category-II(A)/II(B)/III(A)/III(B) candidates, and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST/OBC Category-I/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Karnataka High Court SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website https://judiciary.karnataka.gov.in between 13.08.2026 and 11.09.2026.
